	if !$_input_alias_6 and $_driving_pulse1_last_down

	if $_driving_counter1 > 0.1
		$_driving_counter1 = 0.1
	if $_driving_pulse1
		$_driving_counter1 = 0
	var $_input_alias_7 = input_number("seat", 7)
	var $_expr6 = ($_driving_counter1+($_input_alias_7*0.9))*$_input_alias_2*$_input_alias_6

	var $_driving_pulse2 = 0
	if !$_input_alias_6 and $_driving_pulse2_last_down
		$_driving_pulse2!!
	$_driving_pulse2_last_down = $_input_alias_6
	$_driving_counter2 += $_expr8
	if $_driving_counter2 > 1
		$_driving_counter2 = 1
	if $_driving_pulse2
		$_driving_counter2 = 0
	output_number("yaw", 0, $_driving_counter2)
	var $_input_alias_8 = input_number("seat", 6)
	var $_expr9 = ($_input_alias_8*0.5)
	output_number("yaw", 1, $_expr9)

		$_driving_pulse3!!
	$_driving_pulse3_last_up = $_input_alias_9
	output_number("groundlight", 0, $_driving_pulse3)

function @ore($ore:text):text
	if $ore == "Al"
		return "Aluminium"
	elseif $ore == "Cr"
		return "Chrome"
	elseif $ore == "Cu"
		return "Copper"
	elseif $ore == "Au"
		return "Gold"
	elseif $ore == "Fe"
		return "Iron"
	elseif $ore == "Pb"
		return "Lead"
	elseif $ore == "Ni"
		return "Nickel"
	elseif $ore == "Si"
		return "Silicon"
	elseif $ore == "Ag"
		return "Silver"
	elseif $ore == "Sn"
		return "Tin"
	elseif $ore == "Ti"
		return "Titanium"
	elseif $ore == "W"
		return "Tungsten"
	elseif $ore == "U"
		return "Uranium"
	elseif $ore == "C"
		return "Carbon"
	else
		return $ore

function @batteryGauge($x:number,$y:number,$blank:number,$screen:screen,$value:number)
	var $batColor = 0
	if $value >= 30
		$batColor = color(0,80,0)
	else
		$batColor = color(100,40,0)
	if $value <= 20
		$batColor = color(100,0,0)
	$screen.draw($x+0,$y,$blank,18,8)
	$screen.draw($x,$y,color(100,100,100),16,8)
	$screen.draw($x+16,$y+1,color(100,100,100),2,6)
	$screen.draw($x+1,$y+1,black,14,6)
	$screen.draw($x+1,$y+1,$batColor,14/100*$value,6)
	
function @AH($x:number,$y:number,$blank:number,$screen:screen)
	$screen.blank(0)
	var $centerX = $screen.width/2
	var $centerY = $screen.height/2 - 5
	$screen.draw_line(0, $centerY, $screen.width, $centerY, color(0,30,50,150))
	$screen.draw_line($centerX, 0, $centerX, $screen.height, color(0,30,50,150))
	var $pitch = input_number("tiltpitch",0)
	var $roll = input_number("tiltroll",0)
	
	$screen.draw($centerX-4+($roll*$screen.width/2),$centerY-1+($pitch*$screen.height/2)+1,color(0,100,150,150),9,1)
	$screen.draw($centerX+($roll*$screen.width/2),$centerY-4+($pitch*$screen.height/2),color(0,100,150,150),1,9)


	
	
function @drillComposition($x:number,$y:number,$blank:number,$screen:screen,$composition:text)
	var $compositionIndex = 0
	$screen.draw($x,$y,$blank,94,127);
	$screen.draw($x,$y,color(17,17,17),94,127)
	$screen.write($x+1,$y+1,color(0,80,100),"  Composition")
	foreach $composition ($key, $value)
		$compositionIndex++
		$screen.write($x+2,$y+(10*$compositionIndex)+2,color(200,100,0),text("{}:",@ore($key)))
		var $oreTextSize = size(text("{}:",@ore($key)))
		$screen.write($x+3+($oreTextSize*$sc.char_w),$y+(10*$compositionIndex)+2,color(120,120,120),text("{}%",$value*100))

	
	


; For Scanner Widget -----------------------
array $ores:text
array $maxDistance:number
var $oreCursor = 0
var $maxDistanceCursor = 0
var $oreAdd = 0
var $oreRemove = 0
var $maxDistanceAdd = 0
var $maxDistanceRemove = 0
function @oreScanner($x:number,$y:number,$size:number,$blank:number,$screen:screen,$pivot_io:text,$scanner_io:text)
	if input_number("dashtop",8)
		var $color = 0
		if size($ores) == 0
			$ores.append("Fe","Cu","Si","C","W","U","Ti","Al","Pb","Cr","Au","Ni","Ag","Sn")
			$maxDistance.append(60,125,250,500,1000,2000,4000,8000,16000,32000,64000,128000)

		; Ore Selection
		var $offsetX1 = 40
		var $offsetY1 = 44
		if $screen.button_triangle($x+$offsetX1,$y+$offsetY1,$x+$offsetX1,$y+10+$offsetY1,$x+$offsetX1+10,$y+5+$offsetY1,green,green)
			if $oreAdd == 0
				$screen.draw($x-55,$y-42,black,109,150)
				$oreCursor += 1
				$oreAdd = 1
				if $oreCursor > size($ores)-1
					$oreCursor = 0
		else
			$oreAdd = 0
		var $offsetX2 = -40
		var $offsetY2 = 44
		if $screen.button_triangle($x+$offsetX2,$y+$offsetY2,$x+$offsetX2,$y+10+$offsetY2,$x+$offsetX2-10,$y+5+$offsetY2,green,green)
			if $oreRemove == 0
				$screen.draw($x-55,$y-42,black,109,150)
				$oreCursor -= 1
				$oreRemove = 1
				if $oreCursor < 0
					$oreCursor = size($ores)-1
		else
			$oreRemove = 0
		var $oreSelected = $ores.$oreCursor
		
		; Max Distance Selection
		var $offsetX3 = 40
		var $offsetY3 = 58
		if $screen.button_triangle($x+$offsetX3,$y+$offsetY3,$x+$offsetX3,$y+10+$offsetY3,$x+$offsetX3+10,$y+5+$offsetY3,green,green)
			if $maxDistanceAdd == 0
				$screen.draw($x-55,$y-42,black,109,150)
				$maxDistanceCursor += 1
				$maxDistanceAdd = 1
				if $maxDistanceCursor > size($maxDistance)-1
					$maxDistanceCursor = 0
		else
			$maxDistanceAdd = 0
		var $offsetX4 = -40
		var $offsetY4 = 58
		if $screen.button_triangle($x+$offsetX4,$y+$offsetY4,$x+$offsetX4,$y+10+$offsetY4,$x+$offsetX4-10,$y+5+$offsetY4,green,green)
			if $maxDistanceRemove == 0
				$screen.draw($x-55,$y-42,black,109,150)
				$maxDistanceCursor -= 1
				$maxDistanceRemove = 1
				if $maxDistanceCursor < 0
					$maxDistanceCursor = size($maxDistance)-1
		else
			$maxDistanceRemove = 0

			
		var $maxDistanceSelected = $maxDistance.$maxDistanceCursor
		$screen.text_align(center)
		$screen.write($x-98,$y-20,color(100,100,100),text("{}",@ore($oreSelected)))
		$screen.write($x-98,$y-5,color(150,150,150),text("{}m",$maxDistanceSelected))
		output_number($pivot_io, 0, -0.07)
		$screen.draw(0, 0, color(0,0,0,3), $screen.width, $screen.height)
		
		var $half_width = $size
		var $half_height = $size
		var $steps = $size
		var $angle = input_number($pivot_io, 0) * 2pi
		var $xPos = sin($angle)
		var $yPos = cos($angle)
		
		repeat $steps ($i)
			var $step = ($i + 1) / $steps
			var $distance = $step * $maxDistanceSelected
			output_number($scanner_io, $i, $distance)
			var $composition = input_text($scanner_io, $i)
			if $composition.$oreSelected
				if $composition.$oreSelected > 0.7
					$color = color(255,50,50,125)
				else
					$color = color(0, $composition.$oreSelected*255, 0, 255)
				var $xx = (1 - $xPos * $step) * $half_width + $x - ($size * 2)
				var $yy = (1 - $yPos * $step) * $half_height + $y - ($size * 2)
				$screen.draw_point($xx+$half_width, $yy+$half_height, $color)
			$screen.draw_circle($x, $y, $size+1, color(0,30,0))
			$screen.draw_circle($x, $y, $size/2+1, color(0,15,0)) 
			$screen.draw_point($x, $y, red)
	else
		output_number($pivot_io, 0, 0)
		$screen.draw($x-55,$y-42,black,109,150)
